nodes.description: Data, import, migration for PostgreSQL/Prisma; no Alembic/SQLAlchemy; cannot touch prod

nodes.label: Name Fallback
nodes.description: Import: derive name from description when name column not mapped; allows SKU+price-only imports

nodes.label: Current Prices Batch Endpoint
nodes.description: POST /api/products/import/current-prices: batch SKUs + listaId → 1 query for products + 1 for prices; avoids throttle 429s

nodes.label: Import Session Persistence
nodes.description: Preview↔execute state in DB import_sessions table; survives Hostinger multi-instance routing

nodes.label: Batch Execution Isolation
nodes.description: Row-level DB errors do not poison entire batch; each row transaction isolated; failed rows reported accurately

nodes.label: Mapping Gate Fix
nodes.description: execute() accepts description-mapped columns without explicit name column; prevents 400 'Mapping incompleto'

nodes.label: BulkDeleteModal (UI)
nodes.description: 3-phase confirmation flow: confirm → enter per-user key → enter masterKey → execute delete.

nodes.label: Master Key (global)
nodes.description: Global password for cascade deletion of products with associated data, independent layer from per-user key.

nodes.label: ProductFormModal (UI)
nodes.description: Modal for product creation/editing, inline per-user key field if modification requires key.

nodes.label: Per-User Key (password)
nodes.description: Optional bcrypt password per user for personal authentication on product edits/deletes.

nodes.label: Incremento: Clave por usuario
nodes.description: Per-user bcrypt password for product mutations, independent of global masterKey.

nodes.label: ProductsService
nodes.description: Service for product lifecycle (FSM), transitions, visibility, publication, bulk operations.

nodes.label: UsersService
nodes.description: Service for user management, roles, per-user key (password), auditing.
